description:
Activate Sash and Waistcoat by paying {1} due to Zirda, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters, Healer of the Pride and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life
Repeat.
